facts.fact: Graphic Online reports President Mahama unveiled the National AI Strategy in Accra on 24 April 2026.
The strategy carries US$250 million for an AI computing centre and US$20 million earmarked for short-to-medium-term implementation, per Graphic Online.

A KNUST professor who helped develop the strategy said a National AI Office under the Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations would be established, with a Responsible AI Authority within the first year; the article also says AI focal persons were designated in ministries.
